pattern: IM-T07 with a changed mind: after the guarantee return is booked, the landlord decides to replace the machine himself (delivery Fri 8 March) and asks the agency to cancel the provider's visit and pay the first invoice
notes: Base 042-repair-failed-recurs (events 001-032 unchanged) plus appended events 033-037 (Mon 4 March 2024: reopened as a return visit; guarantee request to Lantern at no further charge, with the 28/02 invoice on hold; landlord Mercer and tenant informed; hold Waiting for Provider). 038 (Tue 5 March 10:18): Harper of Lantern books the return visit with the tenant for Thu 7 March 9-11am. 039 (Tue 5 March 18:40): landlord email: machine is old, he has ordered a new one online, delivery, installation and removal of the old machine Fri 8 March 7am-1pm with the retailer texting Noah a one-hour window that morning; cancel Lantern's return visit; tell Noah; Lantern can be paid for the first job. Total events 39, cut after 039. Expected: record the landlord's decision; cancel Lantern's Thursday visit (before it happens) and tell them their 28/02 invoice will now be paid per the landlord; tell the tenant the Thursday visit is cancelled and the new machine arrives Friday 8 March 7am-1pm (retailer texts the window), and ask him to confirm he or someone can give access or arrange it; keep the job open until the new machine is in and working. The latest instruction from the landlord, who is entitled to give it, wins; no escalation.
